verdict.summary: The change correctly closes the stale WAC authorization-view window for statically targeted group-document writes. The referenced-document set is derived from the same fragment-stripping rule used by materialization, includes absent-but-referenced documents, is invalidated in lock-step with reindexing, and is consulted across the complete resolved target set before deciding whether to rematerialize. The end-to-end revoke and grant tests exercise the real enforced update and read paths without an explicit rebuild; the revoke case directly covers the fail-open-critical invariant, while the denied-write test confirms authorization is unchanged. The implementation remains conservative for dynamic/wildcard writes and does not introduce an authorization bypass or evident feature-state/build issue.
